It fails if removing the mid-frame submit changed what the GPU does (render-pass splits, load/store), which would also mean pixels could move. P6 is a guess and is labelled as one: B never holds more than 2 overflow pools. The index is reset by the flip finish while the pools stay, so one 4,096-set pool covers the ~1,950 sets per frame. It fails if the index is not reset per frame, and the cap then decides. Must-not-move (golden) legs are a separate disc arm: docs/testing/predictions/aufire412-uboring-goldens.json.
